steps.name: pomodoro-0-wake
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; python3 tools/host_wake_test.py | tail -1 | grep -q 'RESULT: pass' && python3 tools/host_wake_test.py --mutations && python3 apps/sdk/orbsdk.py binds && grep -q '"wake"' apps/sdk/binds.json && grep -q 'orb_wake' apps/sdk/orb.h && grep -q 'orb_wake' apps/README.md && ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang make check-apps

steps.name: pomodoro-1-pure-core
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; test -f apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.h -a -f apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.c -a -f tools/host_pomodoro_test.py && grep -q pm_pos_step apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.h && grep -q pm_restore apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.c && ! grep -qE '#include +"orb' apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.c && gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I apps/pomodoro -c apps/pomodoro/pomodoro.c -o /dev/null && python3 tools/host_pomodoro_test.py && python3 tools/host_pomodoro_test.py --mutations | tee /tmp/pomodoro1m.log && grep -qE 'mutants caught ([0-9]+)/\1' /tmp/pomodoro1m.log && ! grep -q MISSED /tmp/pomodoro1m.log

steps.name: pomodoro-2-app
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; test -f apps/pomodoro/main.c -a -f apps/pomodoro/version.txt && grep -qx v1.7.0 apps/pomodoro/version.txt && for s in orb_ring_set orb_ring_clear ORB_RING_BREATHE ORB_RING_FLASH ORB_RING_STEADY pm_restore pm_pos_step; do grep -q "$s" apps/pomodoro/main.c || { echo "missing $s"; exit 1; }; done && grep -q 'ORB_EXPORT("orb_push")' apps/pomodoro/main.c && grep -q 'ORB_EXPORT("orb_service")' apps/pomodoro/main.c && grep -q '"show": "none"' apps/pomodoro/app.json && python3 -c 'import json,sys;s=json.load(open("apps/pomodoro/app.json"))["settings"];vis=[x for x in s if x.get("show")!="none"];ids=sorted(x["id"] for x in vis);want=sorted(["focus_len","break_len","long_len","focuses","autostart","chime","chime_vol","wake","ring_on","ring_op","ring_dir","ring_start"]);ok=ids==want and len(s)<=16 and len(s)-len(vis)<=4 and not any(x["type"]=="color" for x in s) and all(len(x.get("help",""))>20 for x in vis);print("settings",ids);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)' && grep -q orb_stage_values apps/pomodoro/main.c && grep -q orb_wake apps/pomodoro/main.c && python3 -c 'import sys;s=open("apps/pomodoro/main.c").read();b=s[s.index("orb_service"):];j=b.find("ORB_EXPORT",10);b=b[:j] if j>0 else b;bad=[n for n in ("orb_stage_","orb_cv_","orb_ui_","orb_blob_load") if n in b];print("orb_service names "+repr(bad) if bad else "orb_service draws nothing");sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)' && ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang make check-apps && python3 tools/host_pomodoro_test.py --mutations
